item.title: Central Phuket development in Thailand to undergo US$836 mil expansion
item.description: Central Phuket, a landmark mixed-use development in Phuket, Thailand, is set to undergo a US$836 million ($1.06 billion) expansion. Central Pattana, the retail-led real estate arm of Thai conglomerate Central Group, which owns the property, announced on March 2 that the expansion will increase Central Phuket’s total space by 40% to approximately 500,000 sq m (5,382,000 sq ft). item.title: Lentor Central GLS site’s highest bidder is GuocoLand, Intrepid, TID consortium with $1,278 psf ppr offer
item.description: The tender for a government land sale (GLS) site at Lentor Central closed on Mar 3, drawing five bids. A consortium comprising GuocoLand, Intrepid Investments and TID emerged as the highest bidder, submitting an offer of $657.1 million, which translates to a land rate of $1,278 psf per plot ratio (ppr). item.title: Singapore property resilient, a safe haven as geopolitical tensions mount: ERA, Huttons

item.title: Retail podium at Changi Road development Tedge back on the market at reduced price of $13.88 mil
item.description: The ground-floor retail podium at Tedge, a freehold mixed-use development at 328 Changi Road, has been put up for sale through an expression of interest (EOI) exercise with a guide price of $13.88 million. The price works out to about $2,490 psf on the combined strata area of 5,576 sq ft. item.title: Clifford Centre redevelopment: New office tower The Clifford to offer 405,000 sq ft of office, retail and lifestyle amenities
item.description: The Clifford, an upcoming office development in Raffles Place, is poised to set new benchmarks for sustainability and design in the Singapore CBD. Standing approximately 220m tall, the 35-storey office tower will have 405,000 sq ft of net lettable area, including 360,000 sq ft of premium Grade A office space and 45,000 sq ft of retail and F&B offerings, when completed in 2028. item.title: Capstone Asset to debut Asia Pacfic’s first Autograph Collection Residences with Peylaa Phuket
item.description: Thailand-based lifestyle-led developer Capstone Asset has announced the launch of Peylaa Phuket, marking the debut of Mariott International’s Autograph Collection Residences within the Asia Pacific region. Currently under construction, the development is scheduled for completion in 4Q2027. It forms part of a mixed-use development, sitting adjacent to the Autograph Collection Hotels, which is set to open its doors in 2030.
